title: Fits on all of my pots; works well sometimes; other times it's not so good; size wrong - 2.5 stars
text:
Fits on all of my pots; works well sometimes; other times it's not so good; size wrong - 2.5 stars. First off, the size listed is incorrect. I ordered both the [[ASIN:B094N9WDCN Medium]] and the large (this one). It says this size is supposed to be 8.27 L x 4.92 W x 2.64 H inches for the large and 9.06 L x 4.92 W x 2.56 H inches for the medium which does not make sense because that means the medium is larger than this one. I received both of them and they are the same size.

Second, I originally thought this was wonderful because it worked well with long pasta (linguine). Unfortunately, I tried draining tortellini tonight and the pasta keeps floating above the strainer into the sink. The only way this thing works is if all the pasta stays underneath the strainer and it does not when the pasta is of the small type (think elbows, tortellini, etc.)

This fits on my small, medium, and large pots--even the ones with a slight lip. I just clip it on and then turn over to release the water and hope for the best.

It is BPA-free and heat resistant to 446 degrees Fahrenheit (230 degrees Celsius) and cold resistant to -40 degrees Fahrenheit (-40 degrees Celsius) per the box label.

In summary, I am not pleased with this because the design is such that the pasta can go above the strainer.
